question: What is the meaning of circularity pathways in relation to design for re-use?
description: Circularity pathways in design for re-use involve evaluating components' reuse suitability based on their mechanical properties, material durability and degradation, and remaining service life (Bertin et al., 2022). This approach aims to enhance the efficiency of material reuse and minimize waste throughout the product lifecycle.
